boxlite_sdk_patch.workspace_append:
# Tank observed-runtime compatibility pin; upstream OpenMA source commit is unchanged.
overrides:
  '@boxlite-ai/boxlite': '0.10.6'
boxlite_sdk_patch.policy: Candidate runtime compatibility repair for reproduced mounted-boot and static-loader failures; no production adoption implied
boxlite_sdk_patch.security_basis: Explicitly retain measured BoxLite0.9 Linux native defaults; outer Docker default seccomp/AppArmor remain enabled

source.source_tracked_diff: clean pinned baseline; exact reviewed replay DNS overlay retained unchanged through compilation

build_contract.trust: Locally built operator artifact; evidence hashes are not third-party signed attestation

sandbox_browser.engine: pinned Playwright default Chromium headless shell; no fallback

changes: PostgreSQL typed nullable guards and bigint epoch boundaries
opaque tool/application JSON preserved across runtime protocol envelope case mapping
canonical tool schemas/domain/mappers preserve browser and scheduling controls
browser tools execute through per-session SandboxPort and VM-local Unix-socket Playwright worker
network policy passed from selected environment to BoxLite
native skill descriptors resolve the validated unique manifest directory from compiled ZIPs in every exposure mode
sandbox Python3.12 image supplied with SANDBOX_IMAGE
curated read-only DB/API credentials only; replay excludes API keys
Node24 required by pinned pnpm11, upstream Dockerfile used Node22
